label: OFFLINE EVALUATION of uncertified scratch-recipe checkpoints (r9 arm L symmetry screen, 6,291,456 steps); report only; certifies nothing

conventions.heading_frame: fwd = the root's heading after the spawn turn, lat = its left; origin = spawn midpoint of the two plantar pads; all margins in m
conventions.xcom: CoM_xy + v_xy / omega0, omega0 = sqrt(9.81 / CoM height above the floor), boundary state after each step
conventions.pad_hull: convex hull of the floor-facing corners of each LOADED foot's plantar pad (the declared heel line 0.07 m and toe line 0.21 m from the ankle axis)
conventions.full_hull: pad hull plus the tips of the loaded feet's three digit capsules
conventions.contact_hull: convex hull of the contact points carrying > 0.1 N at the step's last substep
conventions.toe_margin: front edge of the hull at the XCoM's lateral coordinate minus the XCoM's fwd coordinate (negative = XCoM ahead of the toe line)
conventions.signed_margin: distance to the hull boundary, + inside, - outside
conventions.pad_cop: recorder sole_cop: force-weighted pad CoP / pad half-length, +1 = pad toe edge, -1 = heel edge
conventions.whole_foot_cop: recorder foot_cop normalised on the declared span: -1 heel line, +1 toe line (beyond +1 = load on the digits ahead of the pad)
conventions.actuator_force_fraction: |actuator_force| / forcerange bound, max over the 5 substeps of a step
conventions.step: 1-based control step; step k ends at t = k * 0.01 s; steps 1-200 are the gate's settle window

home_keyframe_static.note: world x = animal forward at the home keyframe; pad half-length 0.07 m

kinematic_attribution_com_fwd_shift_m.definition: CoM forward position minus the CoM with that joint group set to its home value, each foot held at its actual pose (mean of the two feet); + means the group's deviation from home carries the CoM forward. Kinematic only (no re-balancing); the closed chain is broken for leg groups.
